POD=$(sudo crictl pods --name bench75757759-pod --state ready -q | head -1)
cat > /tmp/bench75757759/container-priv.json <<'EOF'
{
  "metadata": {"name": "bench75757759-ping"},
  "image": {"image": "docker.io/library/bench75757759-ping:latest"},
  "log_path": "bench75757759-ping.log",
  "linux": {"security_context": {"privileged": true}}
}
EOF
for id in $(sudo crictl ps -a -q --name '^bench75757759-ping$'); do
    sudo crictl stop --timeout 1 "$id"
    sudo crictl rm -f "$id"
done
CID=$(sudo crictl create "$POD" /tmp/bench75757759/container-priv.json /tmp/bench75757759/pod.json)
sudo crictl start "$CID"
sudo crictl exec "$CID" /usr/bin/ping -c 1 127.0.0.1
